question: Why do prospectively-valid M4T2 acquisitions sometimes succeed and sometimes fail? Is training-side repeat-estimation geometry instability a reproducible failure mode?
core_principle: separate TRAINING-SIDE geometry instability from HELD-OUT performance: per M4T2 schedule compute a training-ONLY pair-vs-complement geometry-agreement Q from calibration residuals; correlate to the ALREADY-SEALED O2.14 held-out robustness margin. No held-out result defines/tunes Q.

primary_cell.per_fold: 100 identity subsets x 28 two-repeat subsets = 2800 schedules; all schedules; no filtering

reuse_o2_14.held_out_source: regenerate M4T2 per-schedule R_SCHEDULE/TOTAL/FCF/ROBUSTNESS_MARGIN from source with the EXACT O2.9 estimator (O2.14 persisted only aggregates); bind to O2.14 seal by reproducing coverage/margin-quantiles/SS-decomposition to <=1e-10

pair_complement.PAIR: the 2 selected repeats {a,b} (fits the actual M4T2 schedule)
pair_complement.COMPLEMENT: the other 6 repeats (training-side reliability reference ONLY, never fits the schedule)
pair_complement.disjoint: PAIR and COMPLEMENT disjoint in trial observations (certified)

residuals.identities: the 4 calibration identities of subset C

within.P_IN_PAIR/COMP: top-q deterministic SVD in target-native space

residual_reliability.purpose: separate raw repeat unreliability from SVD/subspace instability

within_fold_association.per: subject x ROI x fold (2800 schedules)

support_rule: REPEAT_GEOMETRY_STABILITY_ASSOCIATION_SUPPORTED iff ALL: median participant rho>0; >=6/8 rho>0; Holm reject (no rho-magnitude threshold; directionality not causality)

success_failure_contrast.split: sealed O2.14 sufficient vs insufficient schedules within subject x ROI x fold

single_repeat_quality.per_position_t: leave-one-repeat-out: delta_t vs delta_LOO_t (mean of other 7); native/within/outside cos2 + relative squared error; identity->fold->participant

repeat_additive_model.per: subject x ROI x fold x component; average Q over 100 identity subsets -> Q_pair(a,b) for 28 pairs
repeat_additive_model.model: Q_pair(a,b)=beta0+alpha_a+alpha_b+error, sum_t alpha_t=0, OLS no regularization

repeat_position_loso_consistency.per_roi_component: 8-position quality vector per participant; pairwise Spearman among 8; LOSO donor-consensus vs target rho; report median LOSO rho

identity_repeat_interaction_alignment.residualize: remove grand mean + identity main + repeat main -> Y_INT, Q_INT

program_status.REPEAT_GEOMETRY_INSTABILITY_SUPPORTED_AS: >=1 component supported in BOTH primary ROIs
program_status.ACQUISITION_FAILURE_MODE_MULTIREGIME: supported components differ materially by ROI
program_status.SCHEDULE_FRAGILITY_NOT_EXPLAINED_BY_REPE: neither ROI establishes a supported component

prior_comparator.o2_12_hybrid: schedule-level variability for M2T1/M2T2/M4T1/M4T2 with the frozen one-pseudo-observation prior

no_post_hoc_good_repeat: even if some positions/pairs look better, do NOT promote them: no rerun O2.9 on good repeats, no redefine T, no best pair, no new minimum, no validated rule. O2.15 is DIAGNOSTIC; any rule needs independent prospective validation.
no_causal_labels: use REPEAT-POSITION / REPEAT-ESTIMATION INSTABILITY; do NOT say fatigue/scanner drift/adaptation/physiological unless independently measured

control_replays.A: regenerate M4T2 per-schedule metrics from source; reproduce O2.14 aggregates <=1e-10
control_replays.B: average regenerated M4T2 schedules -> O2.9 participant M4T2 metrics <=1e-10
control_replays.C: reproduce O2.14 coverage + margin quantiles + ID/repeat/interaction SS decomposition <=1e-10

synthetic_controls: 9 additive model recovers planted single-repeat effects
15 no good-repeat selection path in scientific code

claim_boundaries.positive: within the tested M4T2 protocol, schedules whose training-only two-repeat target-state geometry agreed more strongly with the complementary six-repeat estimate were more likely to generalize to held-out imagery identities, supporting repeat-estimation instability as a reproducible source of acquisition fragility
claim_boundaries.additive_positive: some instability was systematically associated with repeat position across participants

next_gate.INSTABILITY_SUPPORTED: O2.16 INDEPENDENT PROSPECTIVE REPLICATION WITH CALIBRATION-QUALITY MONITORING (define a prospective training-only Q monitoring rule for NEW data; freeze before external outcomes; retain M4T2)
next_gate.NOT_EXPLAINED: O2.16 ACQUISITION FAILURE SOURCE EXPANSION (prospectively test limited acquisition-side variables: motion, run/session position, data-quality covariates; no estimator optimization; external replication still required)

O3_policy: O3 remains O3_NOT_READY regardless of O2.15; diagnoses calibration reliability only
